## Potential options for Fusaka upgrade dates 

**Potential options only, dates have not been agreed at ACD, are subject to change, including if issues arise in implementation/testing/security**.  [I am not a core dev](https://x.com/josephdelong/status/1235979765879844864).

Dates won't be set until successful testing on [fusaka-devnet-5](https://fusaka-devnet-5.ethpandaops.io/) [[specs](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/fusaka-devnet-5)].

* Client releases (earliest September 22)
* Holešky testnet upgrade + 1 week after client releases (earliest week commencing September 29)  (Note: https://blog.ethereum.org/2025/09/01/holesky-shutdown-announcement)
* Sepolia testnet upgrade + 2 weeks after Holešky testnet upgrade (earliest week commencing October 13)
* Hoodi testnet upgrade + 2 weeks after Sepolia (earliest week commencing October 27)
* mainnet upgrade + 30 days after last testnet safely upgrades (earliest week commencing December 1)

Data from upgrade scheduler: https://slots.symphonious.net/
Assuming mid week upgrades, if there were multiple options, preference given to Melbourne friendly times.
